name: Metronidazole
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Loading 15 mg/kg over 1 hour (about 1 g), then 7.5 mg/kg (about 500 mg) every 6 hours, starting 6 hours later
Give after the session or add a supplement

key_interactions.action: Avoid during and for 3 days after therapy.

key_interactions.effect: Higher lithium levels and possible kidney damage (label).

common: Confusion, insomnia (listed reactions; no rates given)
serious: Severe cutaneous adverse reactions (TEN, SJS, DRESS, AGEP)
Encephalopathy, cerebellar toxicity, seizures, peripheral and optic neuropathy, aseptic meningitis

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to metronidazole or other nitroimidazoles
Alcohol or propylene glycol during and for 3 days after therapy

pk.half_life_eskd: Metronidazole unchanged; hydroxy and acetate metabolites accumulate (label)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: 60% to 80% of the dose in urine, about 20% of that as unchanged drug

sources.citation: Civica, Inc. (2025). Metronidazole injection USP [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA018657, set ID 902ab25b-d493-495a-884e-96b080e9f72d, version effective November 21, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.
